text:
maria.devex: Hey team — customer Kite Labs reporting console shows 403 when switching projects. API calls with same token succeed. Started after IdP changes last night.

keith.support: Do we have repro steps + any SSO client rotations recently?

maria.devex: Repro steps:
1) Login via Okta SSO
2) Click org/project dropdown -> choose 'infra-prod'
3) Console returns modal 'You do not have permission (403)' and action buttons are greyed out.
This only affects the browser console; their service-to-service API requests still work.

keith.support: Can you paste the network auth header (mask tokens)?

maria.devex: Auth header copy (masked):
Authorization: Bearer ey...XYZ
idp_claims: {"aud":"https://redwood.console","azp":"old-client-id"}

jonathan.sre: If azp (authorized party) is the old client id, console may be checking azp against a whitelist for UI actions. API endpoints often validate aud instead, so API could still accept the token.

maria.devex: Debug log from auth service: "token azp 'old-client-id' not in allowed console clients -> deny 403 (project_switch)"

idp-bot: Audit event: Okta rotated OIDC client_id from 'old-client-id' -> 'new-client-id' at 2026-03-16T21:12:03Z. Existing browser sessions issued before rotation retain tokens until expiry (1h). Console enforces azp whitelist immediately; mismatch causes 403 on project switch.

keith.support: Short-term workarounds:
- Ask user to fully logout, clear session cookies, and re-login to get a token with new azp.
- Admins can temporarily add 'old-client-id' to console allowed azp list (not recommended for long-term).
- Trigger /auth/reauth endpoint to issue fresh session token.

maria.devex: Customer tried logout+login and confirmed it fixed their console 403. They want a short explainer for their security team.

jonathan.sre: Root cause: IdP rotated the OIDC client id without updating console's azp mapping, leaving a temporal gap where existing sessions had old azp. Console's azp check is stricter than API aud validation, so UI flows fail while API calls continue.
Action items:
- Docs: add guidance for OIDC client rotation (session expiry, required re-login).
- Platform: consider a short fallback window that accepts previous azp for N minutes after rotation, with audit logging.
- Alerting: add a detection rule when auth azp whitelist changes.

keith.support: I'll open an internal ticket and send the customer a short note and remediation steps. INT-5423 created. :thumbsup:

maria.devex: Thanks — closing this support thread.
